notes.title: Spooktober Special Update & Other News! Patch Notes for proto v5.0.3
notes.notes:
Surprise! I'm back with style-- I mean the stylizer, a new feature with which you can customize the look and feel of the game. Read on to learn about the latest update, what I've been up to and what's next!

[h2]Alternative Designs[/h2]
Spread: Transmission has always been about customization so a feature to customize the visuals and sounds just had to happen. This update introduces a Prototype 5 "Unleash the Storm"-themed sky, ocean, and rain effects as well as a beach themed island design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43771763/50af0cc5e2caedc9e875b2ea2f59d92bf3096e21.png[/img]
You can find the style customizer in the main menu's options menu. More themes are going to be added in future updates, but I'm going to be completely honest with you, this update was also just an excuse for me to celebrate Halloween, which leads me to...

[h2]Spooktober Special Theme[/h2]
That's right! For the month of October you can also play with a limited-time Halloween theme. This theme includes a night sky, a polluted ocean, an island covered with tombstones and candles, and most importantly ghostly new friends haunting the islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43771763/0b8f4b0f4e177de2de7a8eb5f4c2bf92723227e0.png[/img]
Seasonal themes get selected automatically at the beginning of the month (you can disable this in the options menu). More seasonal themes may be added in future updates.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]⭐ Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Become an island designer and switch up the game's look. Choose freely between different styles from the base game, beach or "Unleash the Storm"-collection.
[*] Celebrate the spooky month of October with the limited-time Spooktober special style. This set includes new island decoration, night sky and scary new friends!
[/list]
[h3]🪶 Change[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed campfire particles as they no longer suited the game's style.
[/list]
[h3]🔧 Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Water quality will now actually be affected by the chosen graphics option.
  [*] Fixed a light and shadow configuration error. This should improve the game's visuals and performance.
  [*] Island decoration can now spawn on the outer parts of the island again.
  [*] Double charge cells should no longer cause the game to occasionally freeze (if you are still experiencing issues, please reach out to me on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord server[/url]).
  [*] "Choose Labs"-prompt will now properly scale with the screen size.
[/list]
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]So it's been a year, what happened?[/h2]
Originally, this update was supposed to release last October, it was mostly complete albeit being cut short due to Unity's license changes. Back then I had to invest a lot of time researching what these changes meant for the game because it was not properly communicated and in the end, I had to cancel the update altogether since I kept running into these sneaky changes and I just didn't have the time to deal with them.

While I wasn't very surprised by this development, it has been extremely demoralizing. So, I started exploring my options. My plan was to port the game to an engine that provides more stability than Unity, that way I don't need to worry about any shady business practices anymore. I tried different engines and even started working on a custom one, however I quickly realized that while I would love to do that, I just didn't have the time to remake the entire game and to be completely honest, I would also love to work on a different game at some point. As much as I love Spread, it was meant to be a small project, but things rarely go according to plan in game development.

At this point, six months already passed and a couple of opportunities for pitching the game arose, so I started focusing on that for a while. For one of those pitches I created a proof of concept web version of the game, that can also be played on mobile. I wasn't able to just port the entire game, as this would've taken too long for a mere proof of concept, instead I created a very simple visually re-imagined version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43771763/4049248857626bd06da5e388f4893de1cfe9593a.png[/img]
I want to reiterate that this is very much a proof of concept and about as stable as the very first prototype of Spread: Transmission, nonetheless if you are interested you can try this version out for yourself as it is available as activity on the [url=https://discord.gg/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord server[/url]. You can even install the activity to your account and play it anywhere you want afterwards! Just note that this version of Spread: Transmission only includes the base mode and is Multiplayer only.

And now you are pretty much caught up! Nothing came of these pitches except the web version of Spread, so I once again gave up on the hunt for publishers and started focusing on finishing the game.

[h2]What happens next?[/h2]
Next, I believe it is time to work on the 1.0 version of the game. For the full release of Spread: Transmission, I'm planning on shifting the focus towards casual players and I will be introducing features meant to make the game more self-explainable, for example by highlighting cells that are able to spread or by providing more contexts about certain moves (explaining why a move could be good or bad). This update will also include the final Lab called 'Item Lab', introducing a whole new world of possibilities to the game. These are my main priorities for now, but I will keep you posted about any developments and changes.

My life is pretty stressful right now, but I hope I will have more news for you soon! For now, I hope you'll enjoy this little Halloween treat. Feel free to share your thoughts either here, on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/]Steam forums[/url], or our [url=https://discord.gg/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord server[/url]. Talk to you soon!

~ Cave 💛

notes.title: Rather big patch incoming! Patch Notes for proto v5.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey there! This was meant to be a quick and small patch fixing the most recent issues, but I got really carried away and now it's the largest documented patch of this game's history, whoops! Enjoy this plethora of fixes and improvements. I even sneaked a couple of new features in here.

[h3]⭐ Highlight[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now optionally choose Labs they want to play with before creating a Lobby!
[/list][h3]✨ Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New achievement for winning a match with Labs enabled for the first time
[*] New overall volume slider
[/list][h3]🪶 Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bot difficulties now have names to set some expectations
[*] On keyboards and controllers, targeting cells is now only available while it's the player's turn, to avoid confusion
[*] On keyboards and controllers, slider inputs may now increase the step size when there are more than 50 valid slider positions
[*] On controllers, slider inputs are now counting slower to allow for more granular input
[*] Movement, rotation and zoom speed for keyboards and controllers have been adjusted
[/list]
[h3]🔧 Fixes[/h3]
[b]📦 Box Lab & Cell Lab[/b]
[list]
[*] Spread charges may no longer teleport to the target cell when colliding with a box
[*] When cells rotate or turn into a double distance cell, boxes will no longer get lost
[*] Boxes will now obey the laws of physics when a cell rotates
[*] Cell icons should now stay unaffected from the cell's rotation
[/list][b]🎮 Keyboard & Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*] On keyboards and controllers, slider inputs should now be able to reach their minimum and maximum values consistently
[*] On controllers, slider inputs will no longer count faster when counting up than when counting down
[*] Keyboards no longer need a controller to be attached in order to charge cells
[*] Zooming with the keyboard should no longer change the game's control scheme to controller
[/list][b]📃 General[/b]
[list]
[*] Pause menu will no longer be dismissed when clicking on anything that isn't a button
[*] Some text wrapping issues in the pause menu have been resolved
[*] Achievement indicator will now update when a new player joined the lobby
[*] Camera speed is no longer affected by the game's frame rate
[*] Drastically improved the loading speed of the main menu for players with many replay files
[*] Spread charges jumping into the fog should now render correctly
[/list]
That's all for this week! As always, thanks for playing and if there is anything you'd like to share or discuss, make sure to check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord server[/url].

~ Cave 💛

notes.title: Happy Patch Day! Patch Notes for proto v5.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey! I've spent the day ironing out some of Prototype 5's quirks. Here's what's changed:
[list]
[*] "Try something new!" achievement should now be properly obtainable
[*] Bots will no longer favor single cell moves in some map and turn order combinations
[*] Players who have no valid moves will now get skipped to prevent softlocks in Cell Lab
[*] Fog Lab will now treat "Locked"-Cells the same way as occupied cells, making Fog Lab + "Locked"-Cells an interesting new mix 👀
[*] Map names should now be properly aligned
[*] Fixed a localization issue inside the pause menu
[*] In Fog Lab, cells that spread instantly will now get rendered properly
[/list]
Thanks for playing and as always, your feedback is greatly appreciated! If there is anything you'd like to share, feel free to reach out on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord server[/url].

~ Cave 💛

notes.title: Open Beta Announcement, Developer Update and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm Cave, the lead developer of [i]Spread: Transmission[/i]. Today I'd like to announce the details of the upcoming Open Beta event, our participation at Steam Next Fest this month, the current state of the game, and more!

[h3]Open Beta Details and Steam Next Fest Participation[/h3]
Let's get the most important news out first! Spread: Transmission is set to launch into Open Beta [b]next week[/b]! You will be able to try the full game at its current state for free, until the Open Beta event ends after [b]25 days[/b]. This is your chance to see whether you or your group of friends is up for this little casual strategy board game. In this post I will go into detail about the new version and the current state of the game.

Spread: Transmission will also be participating at this month's [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! The community has always been a vital part of the game's development and I am eager to share my vision with more people. There is also a small content update planned to drop just before the start of the Steam Next Fest, so keep an eye out for that as well! 👀

[h3]Welcome Prototype 4[/h3]
About three months ago, Prototype 3 launched into Closed Beta and I am delighted to see that players are just as excited as I am about the Labs and their possibilities. I am equally thrilled to announce that Prototype 4 will debut at the Open Beta launch next week! This update I focused on various quality of life improvements to the game as a preparation for the upcoming event, so it ended up being a lot more technical than originally anticipated and there is not a lot of visually fancy things for me to share. Nonetheless, there are still some game-changing additions:

[b]Enjoy a match all by yourself with the newly added bots![/b]
Bots to challenge alone has been a highly requested feature ever since the very first proof of concept way back in 2021. Sometimes you just want to enjoy a match of Spread, but you can't exactly put a group of people together because you are [i]actually[/i] supposed to be doing something else... well now you can. Hooray, procrastination! While the first iteration of bots is not final at all, it should already provide a sufficient challenge to both new and experienced players. You can customize the bots' difficulty within the lobby's options menu, so feel free to start at a lower difficulty level if you just began your Spread journey.

Adding bots to the game was a long and treacherous adventure, it's the feature I spent the most time on this prototype by far, but I am very content about the results. Bots currently provide the best experience at regular Spread, but should also work just fine in combination with Labs. Please let me know your opinion on the current difficulty levels and also if the bot causes any performance issues on your device. Also, if you manage to defeat the bot on its highest difficulty setting at a regular game of Spread, feel free to post a video on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSVeUsmXDK]official Discord server[/url]. 👀

[b]Full controller support[/b]
Yes, you are no longer restricted to the bounds of your desktop! Try playing the game on the big screen with a controller or on the small screen, like a Steam Deck. Thanks to the usage of Steam Input, a wide variety of devices should be supported, enabling many different unique setups.

Please note however, input is currently shared across all input devices and is not independent for each player on the same machine. This will likely change in the future, enabling users to assign input devices to specific players. Tests were performed with a DualShock4 controller in combination with a mouse and keyboard. If you experience any issues with the same or a different setup, please share your experiences in either the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/1/]Steam Forum[/url] or on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord[/url]. I will post a separate announcement with more details regarding Steam Deck compatibility in the days leading up to the Open Beta launch.

[b]Other technical changes[/b]
Even though there is not much to see, a lot of changes happened behind the scenes! One of the more exciting quality of life changes is the return of the quick join feature! All your online friends that are currently inside a lobby appear here for you to join, without leaving the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43771763/3ffaaaae8d5708f2fdc3037f604c423c4b52589d.png[/img]

I also drastically improved the host migration logic, so the game can continue if your host decides to leave. Another small addition is the new, optional drop-in feature, allowing players to join a match even after it has already started. This way you don't have to wait for your whole group to assemble, people can join the beginning of a game even if they are a little late.

[h3]State of the Game: What to expect[/h3]
Finally, let's address the contents of the Open Beta. During the Open Beta event, you will be able to experience the full game in its current state. Major features include:

[list]
[*] Interactive Tutorial
[*] 3 out of 5 planned game modes (including the base game mode)
[*] Over 20 playable maps
[*] Ability to play on custom maps (level editor not yet included, learn how to create custom maps [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1926530/view/3378282226105732241?l=english]here[/url])
[*] Singleplayer (against Bots), local & online multiplayer for up to 8 players
[/list]

As the game is still in development, you may experience some bugs or encounter unpolished features. Your feedback is invaluable and key to improving the state of the game. As always, if there is anything you'd like us to know, feel free to reach out on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926500/discussions/1/]Steam Forum[/url] or on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord[/url]! For the sake of transparency, I compiled a list of the most notable issues with the current version of the game. 
[list]
[*] Random matchmaking will be absent from the initial version of the open beta, so you will only be able to play against bots and friends for now
[*] [strike]Due to some technical limitations, an internet connection is currently required to access most features of the game (This will get addressed in a future update)[/strike] [Update: Experimental support has been added for the ability to play offline!]
[*] Replays of matches with Box Lab enabled currently experience various issues during playback
[/list]

[h3]Closing words...[/h3]
I've been looking forward to this event for years and I am so excited that it is finally happening. If you are even remotely as thrilled as I am, consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926500/Spread_Transmission/]wishlisting the game[/url] or joining our little group on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KSVeUsmXDK]Discord[/url]. Either way, I can't wait to hear your feedback, see you in a week! ːluvː
